titre: How do I book a pitch?
texte: By email or by phone: there is no online booking. The easiest way is to fill in the request form with your dates. We reply by email to confirm availability.
From April to October. The gate is open from 07:30 to 22:30.
Arrivals are between 08:30 and 20:00. Pitches are usually free from 11:00. Outside reception hours, ring the bell on the left-hand shutter.
Yes, dogs and cats are welcome, at €2 a night.

titre: Is there electricity on the pitches?
texte: Yes, at €5 a night. We also hire out an electric cable (€1, with a €30 deposit) and an adapter (€30 deposit).
The campsite is in a high wildfire risk area, so open fires and charcoal barbecues are not allowed. Electric or gas barbecues are permitted, with a single gas bottle per set-up.

titre: What address should I put in the GPS?
texte: Not the postal address: type “Allée de Clairac, Béziers” or the coordinates 43.362408, 3.319105. The last few kilometres are on a well-kept dirt track.

titre: Can we get fresh bread in the morning?
texte: Yes. Order at reception the day before, then collect your bread and pastries the next morning between 08:30 and 11:30.

titre: What if we have no tent or motorhome?
texte: The estate also has a cottage: a self-contained house with a fully equipped kitchen, a bathroom and a shady garden. Write to us for its availability and price.
